passages.text: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God is the LORD.
God is their God.
God commanded the Israelites.
Do not make idols for yourselves.
Do not set up a carved image for yourselves.
Do not set up a sacred pillar for yourselves.
Do not place a sculpted stone in your land.
Do not bow down to a sculpted stone.
Obey these commands because God is the LORD your God.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־ תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD commands you.
You must keep the LORD’s Sabbaths.
You must show reverence for the LORD’s sanctuary.
passages.original: אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments, I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God gives commandments and statutes.
You must follow God's statutes.
You must carefully keep God's commandments.
If you do this, God will bless you.
God will give rain at the right time.
The land will produce crops.
The trees in the field will bear fruit.
passages.original: אִם־ בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־ מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God promises blessings for obedience.
You will thresh grain until the grape harvest comes.
The grape harvest will last until it is time to sow seed.
You will have plenty of food to eat.
You will live safely in your land.
passages.original: וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֙יִשׁ֙ אֶת־ בָּצִ֔יר וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־ זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises peace in the land.
You will lie down and sleep.
You will not be afraid.
God will remove dangerous animals from the land.
No sword will pass through your land.
No war will come to you.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא־ תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God promises victory to Israel.
You will chase your enemies.
Your enemies will fall by the sword in front of you.
passages.original: וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָפְל֥וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב

passages.text: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises them victory over their enemies.
Five of you will chase a hundred enemies.
A hundred of you will chase ten thousand enemies.
Your enemies will fall by the sword in front of you.
passages.original: וְרָדְפ֨וּ מִכֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּמֵאָ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְנָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to turn toward you.
God will make you fruitful.
God will multiply you.
God will establish His covenant with you.
passages.original: וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
passages.sermon:
God promises to bless His people with abundance.
You will eat old grain from your previous harvest.
You will still have old grain left when the new harvest comes.
You will clear out the old grain to make room for the new grain.
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃

passages.text: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He will make His dwelling place among you.
He will not despise you.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is present among His people.
God walks among His people.
God is their God.
The people belong to God.
They are His people.
passages.original: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ־ לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃

passages.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD brought you out of the land of Egypt.
You were slaves in Egypt.
The LORD freed you from being slaves to the Egyptians.
The LORD broke the bars of your yoke of slavery.
The LORD made you able to walk upright and free.
passages.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת׃פ

passages.text: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments, and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant, then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God gave them commandments and a covenant.
The people of Israel needed to obey God.
The people of Israel needed to carry out all these commandments.
The people of Israel needed to obey these statutes.
The people of Israel needed to obey all these ordinances.
Otherwise the people of Israel would break this covenant from God.
Then God would act against the people of Israel.
God would bring sudden terror upon the people of Israel.
God would send wasting disease and fever to the people of Israel.
These would destroy the sight and drain the life of the people of Israel.
Then the people of Israel would plant their seed in vain.
Then the enemies of the people of Israel would eat the harvest of the people of Israel.
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ וְאִם־ בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְאִ֥ם אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתַ֔י לְהַפְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ בְּרִיתִֽי׃ אַף־ אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֗ם וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְאֶת־ הַקַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּמְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָרִיק֙ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
passages.sermon:
If you do not obey the LORD, then He will act against you.
He will turn His face against you.
Then your enemies will defeat you.
And those who hate you will rule over you.
You will run away, even when no one chases you.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י פָנַי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְנִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין־ רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God gave them commandments and statutes.
God warned them about disobedience.
If you do not listen to Me after all these punishments,
If you still refuse to obey Me,
I will punish you again.
I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ם־ עַד־ אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּי֙ לְיַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze, and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says, "I will break your stubborn pride.
I will make your sky hard like iron.
I will make your land hard like bronze.
You will use your strength for nothing.
Your land will not give its crops.
The trees in your land will not give fruit."
passages.original: וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ שְׁמֵיכֶם֙ כַּבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶֽת־ אַרְצְכֶ֖ם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה׃ וְתַ֥ם לָרִ֖יק כֹּחֲכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְכֶם֙ אֶת־ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֣ץ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃

passages.text: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about their behavior.
If you act with hostility toward God, you oppose Him.
If you refuse to obey God, you reject His commands.
God will respond to your sins.
God will punish you with plagues.
God will increase these plagues seven times.
God will do this because of your sins.
passages.original: וְאִם־ תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּי֙ קֶ֔רִי וְלֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about punishment for disobedience.
God says, “I will send wild animals against you.”
These wild animals will take away your children.
The wild animals will destroy your livestock.
Your numbers will become fewer.
Your roads will become empty and deserted.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְשִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִכְרִ֙יתָה֙ אֶת־ בְּהֶמְתְּכֶ֔ם וְהִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me, then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about their behavior.
If you do not accept My discipline, I will respond.
If you continue to walk in hostility toward Me, I will act against you.
I will walk in hostility toward you.
I will strike you seven times for your sins.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ם־ בְּאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י קֶֽרִי׃ וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף־ אֲנִ֛י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֑רִי וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ גַּם־ אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says He will punish them if they disobey Him.
God will bring a sword against them.
This sword will carry out the vengeance of the covenant.
The people will gather inside their cities for safety.
God will send a plague among them inside their cities.
God will give them into the hand of their enemy.
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֙מֶת֙ נְקַם־ בְּרִ֔ית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל־ עָרֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֙בֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְנִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵֽב׃

passages.text: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about disobedience.
God says, "I will cut off your supply of bread."
Ten women will bake your bread together in one oven.
They will give you your bread by weight.
You will eat the bread.
You will not be satisfied.
passages.original: בְּשִׁבְרִ֣י לָכֶם֮ מַטֵּה־ לֶחֶם֒ וְ֠אָפוּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְכֶם֙ בְּתַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְהֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְכֶ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me, then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about disobedience.
If you do not listen to Me after all these punishments, I will act.
If you continue to walk in hostility toward Me, I will respond.
I will walk in fury against you.
I Myself will punish you.
I will punish you seven times for your sins.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ם־ בְּזֹ֔את לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃ וְהָלַכְתִּ֥י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בַּחֲמַת־ קֶ֑רִי וְיִסַּרְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אַף־ אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

passages.text: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about the consequences of disobedience.
God says, “You will eat the flesh of your sons.
You will eat the flesh of your daughters.”
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וּבְשַׂ֥ר בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about the consequences of disobedience.
God says, "I will destroy your high places."
God says, "I will cut down your incense altars."
God says, "I will heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols."
God says, "My soul will despise you."
passages.original: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֞י אֶת־ בָּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִכְרַתִּי֙ אֶת־ חַמָּ֣נֵיכֶ֔ם וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ פִּגְרֵיכֶ֔ם עַל־ פִּגְרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וְגָעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says, "I will destroy your cities."
Your cities will become piles of rubble.
I will ruin your holy places.
Your sanctuaries will be empty and wasted.
I will not accept your sacrifices.
I will not smell the pleasing aroma you offer.
God will reject your worship and your offerings.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ עָֽרֵיכֶם֙ חָרְבָּ֔ה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אָרִ֔יחַ בְּרֵ֖יחַ נִיחֹֽחֲכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God will destroy the land.
Enemies will live in the land.
Enemies will see the land.
Enemies will be shocked by the destruction.
passages.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָֽׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֹֽיְבֵיכֶ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says, "I will scatter you among the nations."
I will send you away from your land.
I will pursue you with the sword.
Your land will become empty and ruined.
Your cities will become destroyed and deserted.
passages.original: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ אֱזָרֶ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם חָ֑רֶב וְהָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצְכֶם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְעָרֵיכֶ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ חָרְבָּֽה׃

passages.text: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
He warned them about disobedience.
He said the land would become empty and ruined.
You will be living in the land of your enemies.
While you are gone, the land will rest.
The land will enjoy its Sabbaths.
The land will rest for all the time it lies desolate.
The land will receive the rest it missed before.
passages.original: אָז֩ תִּרְצֶ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י הֳשַׁמָּ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם אָ֚ז תִּשְׁבַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְצָ֖ת אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God warned them about disobeying His commands.
God said He would scatter them among the nations.
Their land would become empty and ruined.
As long as the land is empty, it will rest.
The land will rest because the people are not living there.
The land will have the rest it did not get before.
The people did not let the land rest on the Sabbaths when they lived in it.
Now, while the land is empty, it will enjoy the Sabbaths it missed.
passages.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י הָשַּׁמָּ֖ה תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ שָׁבְתָ֛ה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.
passages.sermon:
Some of you will survive.
You will live in the lands of your enemies.
I will make your hearts weak and afraid.
Even a small sound, like a leaf blowing in the wind, will scare you.
You will run away as if someone is chasing you with a sword.
No one will be chasing you.
You will fall down even though no one is after you.
passages.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵבֵ֤אתִי מֹ֙רֶךְ֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְרָדַ֣ף אֹתָ֗ם ק֚וֹל עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֔ף וְנָס֧וּ מְנֻֽסַת־ חֶ֛רֶב וְנָפְל֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין רֹדֵֽף׃

passages.text: They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
passages.sermon:
God warned Israel about the consequences of disobedience.
God said the people would stumble over each other.
They would fall as if a sword was chasing them.
No one would actually be pursuing them.
They would not be able to stand against their enemies.
passages.original: וְכָשְׁל֧וּ אִישׁ־ בְּאָחִ֛יו כְּמִפְּנֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב וְרֹדֵ֣ף אָ֑יִן וְלֹא־ תִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ תְּקוּמָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹֽיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about disobedience.
God says, “You will perish among the nations.”
You will live in foreign lands.
The land of your enemies will consume you.
You will not survive there.
passages.original: וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְאָכְלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
Some of you will survive.
You will live in the lands of your enemies.
You will waste away because of your own sins.
You will also waste away because of the sins of your fathers.
passages.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֗ם יִמַּ֙קּוּ֙ בַּֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַ֛ף בַּעֲוֺנֹ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖ם אִתָּ֥ם יִמָּֽקּוּ׃

passages.text: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me— and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity, then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
The people sinned against God.
Their fathers also sinned against God.
They acted unfaithfully toward God.
They walked in hostility against God.
God responded with hostility toward them.
God brought them into the land of their enemies.
If the people confess their sins,
If they confess the sins of their fathers,
If their stubborn hearts become humble,
If they make amends for their sins,
Then God will remember His covenant with Jacob.
God will remember His covenant with Isaac.
God will remember His covenant with Abraham.
God will remember the land.
passages.original: וְהִתְוַדּ֤וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺנָם֙ וְאֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־ בִ֑י וְאַ֕ף אֲשֶׁר־ הָֽלְכ֥וּ עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃ אַף־ אֲנִ֗י אֵלֵ֤ךְ עִמָּם֙ בְּקֶ֔רִי וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם בְּאֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם אוֹ־ אָ֣ז יִכָּנַ֗ע לְבָבָם֙ הֶֽעָרֵ֔ל וְאָ֖ז יִרְצ֥וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺנָֽם׃ וְזָכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֣י יַעֲק֑וֹב וְאַף֩ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֨י יִצְחָ֜ק וְאַ֨ף אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר׃

passages.text: For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws and statutes to Israel.
God warned Israel about disobedience.
If Israel disobeys, they will leave the land.
The land will be empty of people.
The land will rest while it is empty.
The land will enjoy its Sabbaths during this time.
The people will suffer for their sins.
They will pay the penalty for their iniquity.
They rejected God's ordinances.
They abhorred God's statutes.
passages.original: וְהָאָרֶץ֩ תֵּעָזֵ֨ב מֵהֶ֜ם וְתִ֣רֶץ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ בָּהְשַׁמָּה֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְהֵ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺנָ֑ם יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֔עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַ֖י גָּעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the Israelites.
The Israelites would be in the land of their enemies.
God would not reject the Israelites.
God would not despise the Israelites.
God would not destroy the Israelites.
God would not break His covenant with the Israelites.
God is the LORD.
God is their God.
passages.original: וְאַף־ גַּם־ זֹ֠את בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֞ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֗ם לֹֽא־ מְאַסְתִּ֤ים וְלֹֽא־ גְעַלְתִּים֙ לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD made a covenant with the fathers of Israel.
The LORD brought the fathers of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
The LORD did this in the sight of all the nations.
The LORD did this to be their God.
The LORD will remember this covenant for the sake of Israel.
I am the LORD.
passages.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵֽאתִי־ אֹתָם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֗ם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם לֵאלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD gave statutes, ordinances, and laws.
The LORD gave these to the Israelites.
The LORD gave these laws through Moses.
The LORD gave these laws on Mount Sinai.
The LORD made these laws to establish a relationship between Himself and the Israelites.
passages.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ וְהַתּוֹרֹת֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה בֵּינ֕וֹ וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
